profile.headline: Forward Deployed Engineer @ Palantir
profile.summary: Graduated from Rutgers University graduating with a B.S. in Computer Science with a minor in Entrepreneurship. Dedicated individual with an enthusiasm for learning new technologies. Passionate about understanding how innovative ideas continue to solve the world's most important problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Built a user management web application streamlining the process of adding, updating, and disabling users with access to an internal transportation management software.

- Accelerated the critical business process from 5 business days to 12 seconds, decreasing execution time by 99.9%.    

- Developed the full stack application using React with JavaScript /TypeScript to implement the front-end and Java Spring Boot to implement the back-end with an Oracle SQL Database.

- Leveraged reactive programming with RXJS for efficient data handling and real-time updates.

- Designed a RESTful web API using JPA that allows the end users to interact with the database.

- Engineered a dynamic PowerShell script to proactively monitor real-time user activity, closing applications displaying sensitive data upon user inactivity.

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams and deployed the scalable data security solution across all American distribution centers to ensure compliance with audit requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Built an application to analyze financial data and generate a detailed budget report in Python and Automation Anywhere using data from Power BI and the company’s document database.

- Prevented an average of $20,000 overspent on 40,000 projects every month.

- Accelerated the business process and reduced completion time by 96%.

- Developed auditing software that automates the saving and exporting of production audit logs to a secured location.

- Designed software that aggregates client purchase information from various unstructured documents and identified data equivalences.

- Created documentation for all software design, configuration, and architecture to facilitate regulation and maintenance.
positions.insights: Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Microsoft Power BI and +4 skills

volunteerExperiences.description: Used the impact of my experience overseas to continue working to break the cycle of poverty in my local community. Responsible for organizing and leading fundraising events, recruiting members, and creating meeting agendas. Persuaded others to contribute a total of $6,000 to also become overseas educators of orphans in poverty.

Educated underprivileged orphans in India with complex practical concepts, enabling them to pursue high paying jobs. Responsible for communicating through language barriers and teaching a fixed curriculum to high risk students. Fostered an interest in learning through a variety of activities.

projects.title: Startup Success Machine Learning Model
projects.description:
Developed a classification model that predicts startup success with 87% accuracy by leveraging financial and operational data.

This project was conducted independently as a research initiative while at Rutgers University. I took the initiative to secure a grant for data from PrivCo, which I used to train my model.

Engineered a feature set from Crunchbase and PrivCo datasets and enhanced data quality by 275% through rigorous data cleaning and feature engineering.

Implemented a linear regression model to predict startup valuations with a mean absolute error of 0.001 with optimized feature selection for model accuracy.

Leveraged the XGBoost library along with Python’s numpy and pandas to develop robust predictive tools that aid in investment decisions and provide entrepreneurial insight into the startup ecosystem.
